literal_meaning: কুকুরের ডাকার শব্দ (woof woof sound of a dog barking)
figurative_meaning_en: Derogatory labeling of an opponent's statements as meaningless or empty rhetoric
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার বক্তৃতা শুনে মনে হলো শুধু ঘেউঘেউ করছে।
বিরোধীরা ঘেউঘেউ করে কিন্তু কিছু করে না।
example_sentences_in_english: His speech sounded like nothing but woofing – all empty words.
The opponents are just barking; they won't do anything.
note: This idiom uses onomatopoeia to mock insubstantial or aggressive but ineffective verbal attacks, common in Bengali political discourse.
